# DatePicker props

## DatePicker Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `weekStartsOn` | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `0` | First day of the week: `0` = Sunday, `1` = Monday, up to `6` = Saturday. |
| `showOutsideDays` | `boolean` | `false` | Fill leading and trailing cells with dimmed days from the neighbouring months. |
| `month` | `Date` | — | The shown month (controlled): any date in it. The arrows, the keys and a click on an outside day then call `onMonthChange` and wait for a new `month`, and a new `value` does not move the view. An Invalid Date, or one before year 1, shows the selected day's month, else today's. Without it, the calendar opens on the selected day's month, else today's, and moves by itself. |
| `onMonthChange` | `(month: Date) => void` | — | Called with the first day of a month, at local midnight, when the user moves to that month: the previous or next month arrow, a key that moves focus out of the shown month, or a click on an outside day. A new `value` that moves the view does not call it. |
| `form` | `string` | — | The `id` of the `<form>` the picker belongs to, for a picker placed outside it. A reset of that form restores the picker. With `name`, `required` or a named `Field.Root`, the date is submitted with that form. |
| `value` | `Date \| null` | — | The currently selected date (controlled). An Invalid Date counts as no date. |
| `defaultValue` | `Date \| null` | `null` | The initial selected date when uncontrolled. A form reset restores it. An Invalid Date counts as no date. |
| `onValueChange` | `(date: Date \| null) => void` | — | Called with the picked date, at local midnight, when the user picks an enabled day (click, Enter or Space). Picking the selected day again also calls it. The pick then asks to close the calendar: an uncontrolled one closes unless `onOpenChange` cancels it, a controlled one when you set `open` to `false`. It is never called with `null`: the picker cannot clear a date. A change to `value` from outside does not call it. |
| `open` | `boolean` | — | Whether the calendar is open (controlled). An open or close by the user then calls `onOpenChange` and waits for a new `open`. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the calendar is open on mount, when uncontrolled. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean, eventDetails: PopoverRootChangeEventDetails) => void` | — | Called when the user opens or closes the calendar, with the event details of Base UI's `Popover.Root`. A pick closes it with the reason `close-press`, as a press on `Popover.Close` does. `eventDetails.cancel()` keeps an uncontrolled calendar as it is. A change to `open` from outside does not call it, and neither does the close that disabling the picker forces (see Disabled in the docs). Do not call `eventDetails.preventUnmountOnClose()`: the picker has no `actionsRef` to unmount the calendar after it. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `"Pick a date"` | Placeholder text shown in the trigger when no date is selected. Takes precedence over `labels.placeholder`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | — | Whether the date picker trigger is disabled. A disabled picker stays closed whatever `open` and `defaultOpen` say. |
| `min` | `Date` | — | The earliest selectable date. |
| `max` | `Date` | — | The latest selectable date. |
| `isDateDisabled` | `(date: Date) => boolean` | — | Predicate function to disable individual dates in the calendar. |
| `name` | `string` | — | Name of the form field. Renders a hidden input that submits the selected date as `yyyy-mm-dd`, or an empty string when no date is selected. A name on a surrounding `Field.Root` wins over this one, as with Base UI's `Field.Control`: the form data, and a Base UI `Form`'s `errors` and `onFormSubmit`, then use the field's name. |
| `required` | `boolean` | — | Whether a date must be selected before the form can be submitted. An empty required picker blocks submission and takes focus. |
| `className` | `string` | — | Classes for the wrapper element around the trigger. The trigger fills it, so set the width here. To style the trigger, use `triggerClassName`. |
| `triggerClassName` | `string` | — | Classes for the trigger `<button>`. They merge after the trigger's own classes, so a conflicting class replaces the default: `h-12` sets the height, and a `text-*` colour also replaces the muted colour of the placeholder. A text size applies with a mouse from `md` up: below `md` and on a touch screen the text stays 16px (see Text Size in the docs). |
| `labels` | `Partial<DatePickerLabels>` | — | Replaces the built-in English strings, e.g. to translate them, including the calendar's. Keys you leave out keep the default from `DEFAULT_DATE_PICKER_LABELS`. |

## Labels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `previousMonth` | `string` | `"Previous month"` | Name of the button that shows the previous month. |
| `nextMonth` | `string` | `"Next month"` | Name of the button that shows the next month. |
| `heading` | `(date: Date) => string` | `(date) => "March 2026"` | The heading above the days, which also names the grid. Gets the first day of the shown month, at local midnight. |
| `weekday` | `(date: Date) => string` | `(date) => "Su" … "Sa"` | The short weekday name that a column header shows. Gets a date that falls on that weekday, at local midnight. |
| `weekdayLong` | `(date: Date) => string` | `(date) => "Sunday" … "Saturday"` | The full weekday name that screen readers read for a column header, in place of the short one. Gets a date that falls on that weekday, at local midnight. If you set `weekday` and leave this out, screen readers read your `weekday` text. |
| `day` | `(date: Date) => string` | `(date) => "Sunday, March 15, 2026"` | Accessible name of a day button. Gets its day, at local midnight. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `"Pick a date"` | Trigger text while no date is selected. The `placeholder` prop takes precedence. |
| `selectedDate` | `(date: Date) => string` | `(date) => "March 15, 2026"` | Trigger text for the selected date. Gets a picked date at local midnight, and `value` as you pass it: format it in the local time zone, not with `timeZone: "UTC"`. |
| `dialog` | `string` | `"Choose date"` | Accessible name of the dialog that holds the calendar. |
